name: shillelagh
lore:
### The Rite of the Verdant Bone: Shillelagh

Among the arts of the Green, few spells are as deceptively potent as *Shillelagh*. To the uninitiated, it is merely a stick; to the Warden, it is the forest’s own fury made manifest.

**Manifestation & Sensation**
As the incantation is breathed, the caster feels the Weave pulse not as a static force, but as a rush of rising sap. It is the sensation of a thousand springs compressed into a single heartbeat. Visually, the wood—be it staff or club—is bathed in an ethereal, emerald luminescence. The grain visibly tightens, becoming dense as cold iron, while phantom leaves may sprout and wither in seconds, signaling the wood’s temporary awakening to a state of primordial hardness.

**The Legend of the First Branch**
Loremasters speak of a nameless hermit cornered by iron-clad invaders within the Deepwood. Lacking steel, he whispered to his weathered walking stick, pleading for the earth's protection. The wood did not splinter against their shields; it shattered them. He taught that one need not forge a blade when the earth provides the very bone of the world.
